description: Source code for GPU video encode accelerator helper functions, including buffer size calculations, bitrate allocation, and frame rate management within the media namespace.

methods.name: GetMaxEncodeBitstreamBufferSize
methods.description: Calculates maximum buffer size based on frame size, empirically determined for 1080p and 1440p, with scaling for larger resolutions.

methods.name: GetEncodeBitstreamBufferSize
methods.description: Returns buffer size scaled for given frame size, bitrate, and framerate.

methods.name: GetFpsAllocation
methods.description: Provides frame rate allocations for different numbers of temporal layers.

methods.name: AllocateBitrateForDefaultEncoding
methods.description: Allocates bitrate based on encoder configuration, supporting spatial and temporal layers.

methods.name: AllocateDefaultBitrateForTesting
methods.description: Generates a default bitrate allocation for testing with specified spatial and temporal layers.
